functionalReqs: Add an expense paid by one or more users
Show balances per user and per group
hints: Model a split type as something that turns an expense into per-user amounts.
Keep a balance sheet: map of (user A, user B) → amount. How do you validate that splits add up?

Expense with a SplitStrategy (Equal, Exact, Percentage) validated by a factory; BalanceSheet updated on each expense; amounts in paise or BigDecimal with remainder distribution; debt simplification by greedy matching of max creditor and max debtor.
problemStatement:
Design **Splitwise**: users add shared expenses in groups, split them equally, by exact amounts or by percentages, and see who owes whom.

As a stretch, simplify debts so the group needs the fewest transactions to settle up.
title: Design Splitwise
